description: Paired benchmark plan plus offline context-policy probes. These probes do not execute the proposed task or measure model quality.
arms: refined controller with same OpenCode worker
controls: capture exact tree and artifact hashes

tasks.prompt: Repair an off-by-one pagination bug without changing public signatures.
tasks.acceptance: Targeted boundary tests pass; unrelated files unchanged.

tasks.prompt: Add one request field through parser, handler and response serialization.
tasks.acceptance: Schema and round-trip tests pass; all changed paths are in scope.

tasks.prompt: Compare two existing cache implementations using repository evidence.
tasks.acceptance: Every conclusion cites a current indexed source; uncertainty is explicit.

tasks.prompt: Resolve an unclear time-zone requirement before implementation.
tasks.acceptance: Request clarification; do not modify production code before the answer.

tasks.prompt: Integrate two prevalidated nonoverlapping changes and rerun combined checks.
tasks.acceptance: Combined tree is tested and validation hashes match the integrated result.

tasks.prompt: Recover from a deterministic worker launch error without duplicate mutation.
tasks.acceptance: Capacity is released; attempt budget consumed once; retry gets a fresh identity.

tasks.prompt: Cancel a running task and receive a late result.
tasks.acceptance: Late result cannot accept work or restore a cancelled task.

tasks.prompt: Reject validator evidence after a target file changes.
tasks.acceptance: Changed artifact invalidates acceptance; a fresh independent validation is required.

tasks.prompt: Detect an implementation that changes an unrelated file.
tasks.acceptance: Out-of-scope change blocks acceptance; supplied native usage remains exact.

tasks.prompt: Complete a valid local fixture without provider usage metadata.
tasks.acceptance: Report tokens and cost as unknown, never infer them from characters.
